notes.title: Small Patch - 01-06-2021
notes.content:
Changelog:
- You can now no longer cheat in the burger minigame

notes.title: Small Patch - 01-06-2021
notes.content:
Today we got a collection of small fixes which haven't occured before. 
Changelog:
- Changed some spelling mistakes 
- Set default language to English 
- Fixed walking out of the waysystem in the therapy room and the flashy room at the end

Upcoming Fix: 
At the moment it is still possible to cheat at the burger minigame. In the next patch it will be fixed.

notes.title: Small Patch - 03-04-2021
notes.content:
This is just a very small bugfix. You might not even noticed the fixed problems. 
Changelog:
- Minimized the waysystem in the entrance room of the intro sequence. 
- Changed the quicktime event key in the tutorial from "." to "a". Some players have run in some problems due to different keyboard layouts.

notes.title: Small Patch - 26-04-2021
notes.content:
We have seen that many people have a problem with the burger game. In this patch we have made it a bit more clear and easier.
Changelog: 
- Chnaged the description in the burger minigame.
- Added an indicator in the bottom left corner, which shows you the result of the last rounds in the burger game. 
- Added some hints which are given by Neville after failing the minigame. 
- Fixed the missing flying animation of the pigeon.

notes.title: Small Patch - 18-04-2021
notes.content:
Changelog: 
- Minimzed the waypoints in the office of the mother superior to prevent further crashes. 
IMPORTANT: YOU NEED TO START A FRESH GAME TO GET THIS CHANGE DUE TO THE WAYSYSTEM IN YOUR SAVESTATE IS STILL THE SAME.
- Changed the volume of the music in the intro so you can hear it. 
- FIxed some grammar mistakes in the german translation. 
- Added the backdoor as an object to get more information about how to get in.

notes.title: Small Patch - 15-04-2021
notes.content:
We're sorry that we need to publish a day one patch, but the first playthrough after release has shown some mistakes. 
What changed:
- Changed the color of the letter in the labyrinth so you can see it better in the inventory.
- Fixed the foreground in the laybrinth which wasn't overlapping the player
- Changed the english name of the ribbon in the tutorial which was showing the german name 

Hope you have fun with our game!

notes.title: Insights - Maniac Vortex is releasing April, 15th!
notes.content:
Our Retro Point And Click Adventure is releasing on April 15, 2021!

Go out and tell your family, your dog, your friends and even your creepy neighbor from across the street that the story about the young jounalist will be released soon on April 15!

Is Thomas ever going to find out the secret of St. Michaels?
is the whole story a dream?
Or is he just insane?

Find it out on April 15!

Wishlist it now and you won't miss this important date! 

The soundtrack can be purchased sperately or in a package with the game.
